<ref>{{Cite web |title=Noah Clowney Stats, News, Bio |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/player/_/id/4712896/noah-clowney |access-date=2023-06-18 |website=ESPN |language=en}}</ref>'''Noah Clowney''' (born July 14, 2004) is an American [[college basketball]] player for [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama Crimson Tide]].

==Early life and high school==
Clowney grew up in [[Spartanburg, South Carolina]] and attended [[Dorman High School]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tuscaloosanews.com/story/sports/college/basketball/2023/01/13/alabama-basketball-noah-clowney-nate-oats-lsu-tigers/69806647007/|title=Noah Clowney: Alabama basketball freshman on confidence ahead of LSU|work=[[Tuscaloosa News]]|date=January 13, 2023|access-date=January 23, 2023}}</ref> As a junior, he averaged 9.6 points, 7.9 rebounds, and 1.4 blocks over 26 games.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.goupstate.com/story/sports/2021/11/01/alabama-basketball-signs-dorman-senior-noah-clowney/6233612001/|title=Alabama basketball lands Dorman senior Noah Clowney|work=[[Spartanburg Herald-Journal]]|date=November 1, 2021|access-date=February 10, 2023}}</ref> Clowney averaged 17.5 points, 9.7 rebounds, and 1.7 blocks per game during his senior season.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://alabama.rivals.com/news/i-was-always-overlooked-clowney-blossoms-in-first-season-with-alabama|title='I was always overlooked': Clowney blossoms in first season with Alabama|first=James|last=Benedetto|website=[[Rivals.com]]|date=December 21, 2022|access-date=January 23, 2023}}</ref>
 
Clowney was rated a four-star recruit and committed to play college basketball at Alabama over offers from [[Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball|Virginia Tech]], [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida]], and [[Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball|Indiana]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tuscaloosanews.com/story/sports/2021/11/01/alabama-basketball-noah-clowney/6241577001/|title=Alabama basketball lands commitment from 4-star forward Noah Clowney|work=[[Tuscaloosa News]]|date=November 1, 2021|access-date=January 23, 2023}}</ref>

==College career==

rebounds.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/alabama/Article/Alabama-Basketball-Freshman-Noah-Clowney-even-more-athletic-than-Crimson-Tide-initially-thought-196309744/|title=Freshman
